restaurantName: Fan Shui Chang Yu Mian (North Jiefang Road)
address: 2-57 North Jiefang Road, Guangling, Yangzhou, China Mainland
bio: This neighbourhood noodle shop rose to fame after appearing on a TV show. Wild-caught rice paddy eel is the main event here. In the noodles in milky eel bone broth, dry noodles tossed in sauces, or fried noodles topped with sautéed eel in a peppery glaze, the umami is pronounced and the textures well layered. The milky broth, which takes six hours to make, is also a highlight. Sample different cuts of the deboned eel for different textures....
pageTitle: Fan Shui Chang Yu Mian (North Jiefang Road)
